title: A person who is good at making things by hand
prompt: Describe a person who is good at making things by hand
bullets: what materials or technologies he/she uses
and why you think this person is good at making things by hand

notes.label: Materials
notes.text: palm leaves, 16 bamboo rings, thread, needle; no machines

part2.question: Describe a person who is good at making things by hand

segments.v: I want to talk about my grandmother. She is very good at making conical hats by hand. She comes from Chuông village near Hà Nội. This village is famous for conical hats. She learned this skill from her mother when she was ten. Now she is more than seventy years old but she still makes hats. She uses palm leaves, bamboo and thread. First she makes the leaves flat, then she puts them on a bamboo frame. Then she sews them together. She does not use any machines. It takes her one day to make one hat. I think she is good at it because she has practised for many years and she is very patient. I tried to help her but I could not do it well. I am very proud of her.

part3.question: Do you think handmade is a good thing?

segments.v: Yes, handmade things are good because they are unique and made with care. But they are expensive.
Generally, yes. Handmade products tend to be
made with care, and they often last longer than
goods. They also keep traditional skills alive and support small

rather than big factories. The downside is price: because they take so long to make, they're usually much more expensive, so they can't replace factory products for everyday needs. I see them more as something special.
